## Où j'en suis
The staging upgrade on branch `noa/rds-pg17` is complete: analytics-staging is on PostgreSQL 17.2, the `pg_partman` maintenance check is green, and dbt passed all 14 models. PR #57 remains open. Production is not scheduled; Maya wants a full incident-free week on staging before sign-off, with the earliest review on Nov 24. (source: ses-pg-3, src-pr57, src-linear-kes298)

- [en-cours] Observe staging on PostgreSQL 17 for a full week; production remains disabled pending sign-off. (source: src-linear-kes298, ses-pg-3)
- [prochaine-étape] After a full week without incident, get Maya’s sign-off and choose the production window; plan a separate reboot window to enable `rds.logical_replication` before the blue/green deployment. (source: src-linear-kes298, src-slack-infra, ses-pg-3)
- [décision] Keep the production date unset until Maya signs off; the runbook now requires enabling `rds.logical_replication` and rebooting before blue/green. (source: s3-09)
